ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally and 35% high-intensity white pixels on distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity black mass extending from the notch to the lower edges; distal regions (outer lobes) contain high-intensity white patches with radiating black brush-stroke patterns/striae.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; narrow angle with deep pixel-depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary; distinct peaks and valleys with amplitude variations of approximately 10-25 pixels across the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing edge leading to pointed, heavily encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular off-white pixel groups localized at both the left and right extreme distal tips (barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like striae) radiating from the central black mass across the high-intensity white pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme barnacle encrustation on the distal tips; visible white crescent-shaped mark in the lower-left central pigmented region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white crescent-shaped mark (annular or semi-circular) located in the lower-left quadrant of the central black pigment.
